payload.comment: Profiling stage is complete and internally consistent. PathMNIST (9-class, 3-channel, 28×28 RGB MedMNIST distribution) is fully loaded with no subsampling; split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) match official sizes exactly. Archive MD5/SHA256 verified and consistent; selected-index SHA256 hashes present for all three splits. No blank images, no duplicate train samples, imbalance ratio 1.634 is modest, and train/val class proportions are nearly identical (max absolute deviation < 0.0001), indicating no split-level distribution shift. Ambiguity risks among visually similar histology classes at 28×28 resolution are appropriately documented and are inherent to the task, not a data defect. The test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K, different clinical center) is correctly flagged for OOD evaluation awareness. No deterministic findings were raised. One minor reproducibility observation: llm_model_digest is null despite llm_model='qwen3.8' being specified in the run manifest; this should be populated before any training or evaluation stage that relies on LLM-in-the-loop decisions to ensure full auditability of model-weight provenance. This does not affect the validity of the profiling artefacts themselves. All schema versions are 1.0, package versions are pinned, deterministic_torch is enabled, and seed=42 is set. The stage is ready to proceed.
llm_issues: llm_model_digest is null despite llm_model='qwen3.8' specified; populate before training/evaluation stages for full reproducibility of LLM-in-the-loop decisions
Test set originates from a different clinical center (CRC-VAL-HE-7K); ensure OOD evaluation protocol accounts for this domain shift when interpreting AUROC aggregates
